##### Project general facts

Flamingo Villas 1 is the first phase of a coastal villa community by RAK Properties, conceived as a small, self-contained neighbourhood with its amenities gathered at the centre. The architecture follows clean geometric forms with light sand-toned facades, contrasting horizontal elements and landscaped private plots. The community offers two- and three-bedroom villas in semi-attached and attached layouts, arranged around the central amenities and along the waterfront, with sea-facing, pool-facing and garden-facing villa types.

Leisure life centres on a well-proportioned adult swimming pool with a pool deck and a separate paddling pool for children. Families have a children's play area with safe recreational equipment, while active residents can use the multipurpose sports court and a covered gym. Green community lawns, landscaped gardens and quiet resting areas complement the grounds, and covered parking and broadband internet support everyday convenience. The ecological surroundings encourage a relaxed, healthy lifestyle close to nature.

The villas come semi-furnished and are planned over two floors, with an open living and dining area opening onto a private garden on the ground floor. Each home includes a separate kitchen, a maid's room, a store and a carport, while the upper floor holds the bedrooms with their own bathrooms and a flexible living room or study. Larger layouts add a roof deck, and private gardens at the front and rear extend the living space outdoors.

##### Location description and benefits

Mina Al Arab is a fully integrated waterfront community on the coastline of Ras Al Khaimah, spread across the mainland shoreline and two man-made islands. The area is planned around its natural setting, with pristine white sand beaches, protected coastal wetlands, dunes and ecological preserves that are home to a variety of marine life. Nature trails with interpretative centres run through the ecological district, while the Lagoon Walk promenade lines the canal with waterside shops, cafes and restaurants.

Daily life in the community is supported by parks and playgrounds, community swimming pools, a hypermarket and a variety of retail and dining outlets. Recreational facilities include gyms, tennis courts, a football field and spas. The adjacent island hosts the Anantara and InterContinental resorts with their restaurants and leisure offerings. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, the Ice Land Water Park, international schools and healthcare facilities are within driving distance.

Mina Al Arab is positioned as a premier waterfront community of Ras Al Khaimah, combining resort-style living with a calm, family-oriented environment suited to families and young couples alike. The presence of internationally branded hotels supports interest from both long-term tenants and holiday visitors. Freehold ownership makes the community an accessible option for investors seeking waterfront property in a quieter setting than the busier markets of the emirates.
